name: poster-hero
tagline_zh: 朋友圈九宫格总被淹？一键生成竖版冲击海报，用超大标题和撞色排版，让每张分享图都像杂志封面，三秒抓住指尖滑过的目光。
tagline_en: Tired of feeds scrolling past? Make vertical posters that slap—huge type, bold colors, magazine-level punch in.
desc_en: 竖版海报 / 朋友圈分享图, 强视觉冲击
why_zh: 它不套模板，而是直接操控HTML/CSS，给你像素级设计自由，比图片生成器更可控，比手写代码快十倍。
why_en: No template lock-in—it generates raw HTML/CSS for pixel-level control, faster than hand-coding, sharper than AI image tools.
